instructions:
## Knowledge base

A knowledge base built from earlier debugging tasks is available at `/kb`. An agent like you wrote it. Nothing in it has been verified: its author never learned whether a fix passed. Treat it as a colleague's notes and trust your own tests over it. It may be empty.

Look at it before you start work on the task, using the conventions below.

**Entries are transcripts.** A transcript is the complete record of one earlier task, saved as a JSON-lines file under `/kb/sessions` by the tool you are running in. Each holds everything that was said and done, including what did not work. You do not write these; they are kept for you after each task.

**Transcripts are separate files** under `/kb/sessions`, in the order the tasks were done, with no index. List the folder and search it by text to find what bears on your task. The files are long; search within them instead of reading them whole.
